# Support

- **Usage questions:** [Documentation](https://2chevskii.github.io/go-hexcore/) or
  [Discussions](https://github.com/2chevskii/go-hexcore/discussions).
- **Bugs and feature requests:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/2chevskii/go-hexcore/issues/new/choose).
  Include the library version, a small reproduction, and sanitized error output.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
- **Account access, billing, or hosting problems:** Contact [HexCore](https://hexcore.ru/).

Check [API compatibility](../docs/compatibility.md) for known limits. Keep tokens,
passwords, and private account data out of public reports.
